For a full address it gives the fetch error (or 'offline and not cached'); for a part of an address it gives '--only matched no cited, linked or cached page'. verdict.reason: Confirmed. Part 2 passes a full address, and for a full address the script never gives the --only reason. The first --only loop puts an uncited, uncached full address into `urls`, and `seen = new Set(urls)` then counts it as matched. A mistyped address therefore shows up as 'offline and not cached' when offline, or as a fetch error when online: the wiki API's missingtitle, or an HTTP 404 that looks like a page that no longer exists. The run still ends INCOMPLETE, so nothing passes silently. But the new sentence tells the reader to look for a message that part 2 cannot produce. Severity low.

findings.summary: countered_by/2 (damage:fire) does not describe something that beats the Thunderhead. findings.evidence: Page: https://tempestrising.wiki.gg/wiki/Garrisoning describes the Penetrating passive as getting through garrisons, though not transports, and hurting the soldiers in them. It lists Explosive - Penetrating weapons (the Grenadier's grenades, the Scrambler's chaff, the Grenade Turret, the Cultivator's pods and the Shepherd's lightning) and Fire weapons (Ignitor, Pillager, Flame Turret). Record: countered_by/2 is 'damage:fire | Fire weapons with the Penetrating passive, such as the Ignitor's flamethrower and the Pillager's flame cannons, hurt infantry sheltering in garrisons such as its Lightning Rod (Garrisoning page).' Rules (docs/fields.md, Matchups): countered_by is 'What beats it; links describe the enemy'. 'A reasoned entry names those facts in its reason and gets an uncertain entry saying it is reasoned.' Rule (1): 'If that link alone drops half the point or covers units the reason is false for ... give that half a second entry.'
findings.fix: Remove countered_by/2. Put the point in weaknesses/0 (pattern:carry-passengers) instead, for example: '...and Penetrating weapons, fire and explosive alike, hurt the infantry inside the Rod (Garrisoning page).' verdict.reason: The main claim does not hold. The Lightning Rod is not a separate building: it is the Thunderhead's own deployable. The Rod page's Codex text has the Thunderhead put its core on the ground, and the Rod grows from it. The record's transport role, its ten seats and its strengths all rest on the Rod. Destroying the Rod kills everyone inside. Fire weapons threaten that garrison in two ways: Penetrating fire hurts the infantry inside, and the Rod is a Structure with no fire resistance, while the Damage page calls fire effective against structures. So the entry does name an enemy that beats the unit's main job. The batch also counts enemies that kill a carrier's riders in countered_by elsewhere: the Battle Bus's countered_by/2 covers crew-killing snipes and neutron shells that kill riders and crew. The 'half the list' point fails too. The reason is explicitly limited to fire weapons with the Penetrating passive, so it is not false. The other half has no fitting link: damage:explosive covers every weapon of the game's Explosive damage type, and the Garrisoning page lists only five of them as Penetrating. Rule (1) forbids a link that covers units the reason is false for, so the proposed alternative (adding a damage:explosive entry) would itself break the rules. That leaves whether the entry is 'reasoned'. That is a judgment call: the Garrisoning page states the Penetrating rule and lists the Lightning Rod among the garrisons it applies to, and the uncertain note cites that page. At worst this is a Low wording point, not a wrong link.
verdict.evidence: tempestrising.wiki.gg/wiki/Garrisoning (cached): Penetrating is described as breaching garrisons, though not transports, the Rod listed with 10 units, five Explosive - Penetrating weapons and three Fire weapons. tempestrising.wiki.gg/wiki/Lightning_Rod (cached): armour type Structure, armorfire 0, armorexplosive 0; the Codex has the Thunderhead put its core on the ground; if the Rod is destroyed, everyone inside dies. tempestrising.wiki.gg/wiki/Damage: fire is effective against infantry and structures. data/games.json, the tempest-rising damage map: Explosive to explosive, Fire to fire. docs/fields.md line 11 (Matchups, rule 1). data/units/generals.json, the Battle Bus's countered_by/2.
